meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Why does my son have a zero?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.
A machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for acting against a student. What else do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn and an apology to Owen, and I will be taking this to the principal. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a visit to the principal; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because no evidence was ever heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because the only thing you gave her was the detector score, and there was nothing in it she could check herself.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and treated it as the reason for the zero, which she dismissed as a machine's guess that its own maker says not to rely on alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you gave no times or documents, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what else you had, answer with one dated document she can check herself, after owning that the zero went in before anyone called her.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
